mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 62 degrees and overcast at Verona Area High School, with a waxing gibbous moon. Although the space station is passing overhead tonight, we will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

Contractors will begin road maintenance on September 28, including crack filling on several streets like South Nine Mound Road and North Jefferson Street. Also, the Plan Commission is meeting on October 5 to discuss various development projects, including a site plan for Sub-Zero.

Today you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow is packed with fun including Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and more throughout the week including the Verona Fall Fest on September 25.
On September 3, a 33-year-old man was arrested for an O W I after crashing his vehicle on Shooting Star Road.
Culver's is currently open until 10 PM, however, the store is closed for a remodel, so the flavor of the day is not available.
